name: genkit-channels
description: Experimental CLI and helper library for exposing a Genkit app's flows and agents over a transport (a "channel") by running the app as a child process and talking to it over reflection v2.

scripts.pretest:discord-bridge: tsc channels/discord/src/bridge.ts --outDir channels/discord/dist --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target ES2021 --skipLibCheck
scripts.test: node test/smoke.mjs && node test/smoke-attached.mjs && node test/agent.mjs && npm run test:discord-bridge && node test/packaging.mjs && node test/service-settings.mjs
